`goravel-authz` v1.16.0 targets Goravel 1.16.x. Install it with
`go get github.com/wcz0/goravel-authz@v1.16.0`.

### Added

- Added the Goravel 1.16 release line, installed with `go get github.com/wcz0/goravel-authz@v1.16.0`.
- The same Casbin capabilities as the other lines: adapter batch add and remove, single and batch update, update by filter, filtered loading and transactional rollback.
- The same HTTP middleware, Gate integration, Artisan policy commands and Goravel logging as the other lines.

### Changed

- `package:install` follows the 1.16 conventions: the provider is registered in `config/app.go`, the migration in `database/kernel.go`, and the config, model and migration files are written directly.
- The commands read `ctx.Arguments()`, because the 1.16 console has no `command.Argument`.
- Logging goes through `log.Writer`, because the 1.16 `Log.Channel()` returns a `Writer` rather than a `Log`.
- Requires Goravel framework v1.16.8, goravel/sqlite v1.4.0 and Go 1.23 or newer.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wcz0/goravel-authz/compare/v0.5.0...v1.16.0
